title: Persist denials and block equivalent actions across retries
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He runs `denial_equivalence`: a denied email.send to bob stays denied across provider/tool retries until `lift()`, while a different recipient is allowed. Native deny/allow paths: `fangore_insp_soft_vs_hard`, `fangore_jev_action_safety`. Tracks MH-DOTS-05[^insp-dots-05].
implementation: `DenialStore` / `InMemoryDenialStore` + `equivalent_action_digest` via product verb `denial_equivalence` (`cli_policy_verbs`); `AuthorityGate` records DENY and consults prior denials. Walk-bag `in`/`out` carry the denied intent and outcomes.
validation: Harness `user_story` walks `denial_equivalence`; expects prior_denial on equivalent retries and allow after lift.
